DIRECT DEPOSIT AUTHORIZATION
Prepared for Jordan Lee · Acme, Inc.

AUTHORIZATION
Jordan Lee authorizes Acme, Inc. to deposit Jordan Lee's pay directly into the account described below, instead of by paper check, until this authorization is changed or revoked.

Bank name: _______________
Routing number: _______________
Account number: _______________
Account type: ☐ Checking  ☐ Savings

CHANGING OR REVOKING THIS AUTHORIZATION
Jordan Lee may change or revoke this authorization at any time by submitting a new form in writing to Acme, Inc. Acme, Inc. will apply the change beginning with the next pay period for which there's enough time to process it.

ACKNOWLEDGMENT
Please sign below to indicate your agreement to the terms above.

Employee: Jordan Lee
Date: _______________

—
